text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hawawawa! The rubber on the heel!? How could it snap off so suddenly like this...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yukino...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wh-what, Taishin-san?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... *sigh*.
Anyway, pull over to the side.
I'm pretty sure there's a repair shop nearby...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"—Whew, you really saved me!
Thank you so, so much!
Here, order whatever you like! It's on me!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I didn't really do anything special...
You didn't need to do all this.

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me~.
Are you ready to order?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes! Um, um, the lemon tart drink set,
with iced tea for the drink!
With foamed milk added! What about you, Taishin-san?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'll have the same thing then.
...Do you come here often?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... Can you tell? This
is my "regular cafe"!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Just kidding, or something like that?
I've been visiting lately hoping it'll turn out that way.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah, I see what's going on.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"City Girls"
frequent cafes, ya know.
This kinda thing is... a "dream" of mine.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it might sound silly
to have such a tiny dream, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I don't think that's true, is it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Btw, it's not like dreams are big or small—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about?
"Making it taste a little better" is a dream in its own right!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ? ...Taishin-san?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah... No...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "...U-Um! Taishin-san!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Earlier... that made me really happy.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I just gotta puff out my chest and say,
"This is my dream...!" right?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Actually... there are tons of other things too!
Like dyeing my hair blonde, getting better at makeup,
and picking out clothes for my little sister back in Morioka...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Also, I want to live in Morioka someday.
Not sure when that'll be, though.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
This is definitely...!
One of the dreams I will absolutely make come true...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Racing comes first right now,
but life is long.
I'm sure we can make all of them come true!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: All of it... huh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
You've got a lot of different core values, don't you.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Fueh? Um... well...
What do you... mean by that...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: N... never mind.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Come to think of it, Flight wasn't just about racing either.
Maybe that's why she's so strong...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Still, it's not like I have anything
I'd call a "dream."
Cooking and gaming are really just ways to pass the time.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Still... even so—)

On my day off, in front of the school gate,
I spotted Narita Taishin, who looked to be returning from an outing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Mm, I'm home.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Not really.

She walked away with a gentle aura around her.
I don't know what happened, but...
I could tell it was a good sign.
